question: Can R73/R72/R66 summaries be reused after changing only isotropic covariance scale while camera, positions, colors, alpha sequence and draw order stay fixed?

preregistered.onlyChangedInput: SPZ isotropic scale byte for every splat
preregistered.positiveControl: recalibrate effective alpha maps and recompute sequential summaries from true Half checkpoints
preregistered.requiredOutcome: position/color/alpha order and camera remain identical; both scale changes alter decoded covariance, effective-alpha and summary digests; recomputed bounds remain conservative; at least one stale-covariance reuse underestimates

evidenceScope: Same Chromium/SwiftShader lineage as R55-R66/R72-R73; uniform isotropic covariance invalidation only, not device validation.
